# ljg-word: deep-dive English word mastery (etymology to epiphany)

Curated by Skill Harbor — @lijigang's ljg-word: a deep-dive English word mastery tool that deconstructs one word into its core semantics — the most physical original image (Incubate = a hen crouched on eggs), a core-image formula (warmth + time + protection = incubation), penetrating multi-domain explanation with bolded keywords — and closes with one philosophical bilingual one-liner that captures the word's soul. Written in Chinese, for Chinese-speaking learners: the skill's instructions and output structure are in Chinese, with an IPA line and Chinese translation in the header. MIT-licensed. Honest notes: English speakers can still use it, but expect the working language of the analysis to be Chinese — this is a learner's tool, not a dictionary API. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
